system.title: Generalised filtering and stochastic DCM for fMRI

topic_app.label: Regionally specific fMRI signal generation
topic_app.detail: Neuroscience framing: random fluctuations in hidden neuronal and physiological states.

topic_ai.label: Inversion of stochastic state-space models
topic_ai.detail: Framed as fitting models with noise on hidden states.

problem.label: Validity of stochastic DCM inversion
problem.detail: Whether DCMs with state noise can be inverted and validated.

application.label: Group differences in an internet addiction fMRI study
application.detail: Construct validity tested on real fMRI data.

family.label: Dynamic causal modeling for fMRI effective connectivity
family.detail: Dynamic causal models of fMRI time series.

novelty.label: Generalised filtering versus dynamic expectation maximisation
novelty.detail: Compares schemes that do and do not ignore dependence between states and parameters.

result.label: Inversion of stochastic DCMs is feasible
Face validity with veridical connectivity estimates
result.detail: Bayesian model comparison separates high and low physiological noise data.

Relaxing conditional independence aids construct validity
